motds.body: Make your choice and settle the score… do you side with The Foundation or The Ice King? Choose your Team, win Rivalries, and climb the Leaderboard to unlock new loot!
motds.title: The Showdown Begins Now!

motds.body: Two teams. One winner! The Island's fate hangs in the balance as the Fortnite: Shattered Season 2 End Event kicks off on June 5. Doors open at 6:20 PM ET and the event begins at 7 PM ET. Watch it unfold live.
motds.tabTitle: The Future is Decided in Fortnite: Shattered
motds.title: The Future is Decided in Fortnite: Shattered

motds.body: Fight for The Foundation or The Ice King and best your Rivals to unlock powerful gameplay loot and cosmetic rewards for all!
motds.title: The Showdown

motds.body: Power isn't given, it's taken. Chapter 7 Season 3 arrives June 6!
motds.title: Runners Drop In on June 6

motds.body: Attend the Shattered event on June 5 at 7 PM ET and earn the Chaos Cutlasses Pickaxe. Attend the event with one or more friends and your whole party will get the Bark Voyager Sidekick! Rewards will be granted after the next Battle Royale Season goes live.
